Marp Presentation Skill by DavidElsdoerf.explanation: 本地Marp技能和CLI用于Markdown演示文稿，支持品牌快照切换、本地实时预览、演讲者视图HTML和PDF导出、便携式演示文稿存档，以及PowerPoint主品牌提取和比较；需要Node、Python和Chromium；可选使用LibreOffice、Poppler和ImageMagick；品牌素材保留原有条款。
useCases: 制作可导出为HTML和PDF的演示文稿
提取和比较PowerPoint品牌模板
Marp Presentation Skill by DavidElsdoerf.originalDescription: Local Marp skill and CLI for Markdown decks with interchangeable brand snapshots, localhost live preview, presenter-view HTML and PDF export, portable deck archives, and PowerPoint-master brand extraction and comparison. Requires Node, Python, and Chromium; LibreOffice, Poppler, and ImageMagick are optional import tools. No separate model API or GPU is required; imported logos, fonts, and templates retain their own terms.

Circuit Diagram Skill.name: Circuit Diagram Skill
Circuit Diagram Skill.summary: 将英文直流电路描述转换为电路符号、图表和可选解题步骤的本地工具
Circuit Diagram Skill.explanation: 该工具通过本地技能和Python命令行界面，将英文直流电路描述转换为检查过的电路符号、Schemdraw和Matplotlib工作表图表，并生成PNG/SVG/PDF文件。支持US和IEC符号配置，首次运行需要网络访问安装依赖。渲染无需单独模型API或GPU，由主机代理处理不符合确定性短语规则的描述。
useCases: 将英文电路描述转换为图表文件
生成可选的串并联解题步骤
Circuit Diagram Skill.originalDescription: Local skill and Python CLI translating English DC-circuit descriptions into checked circuit notation, Schemdraw and Matplotlib worksheet diagrams, PNG/SVG/PDF files, and optional worked series/parallel solutions. US and IEC symbols are configurable; first-run dependency installation needs network access. Rendering needs no separate model API or GPU, with the host agent handling descriptions outside the deterministic phrase rules.

GeoGebra Skills by luzwales.name: GeoGebra Skills by luzwales

GeoGebra Skills by luzwales.explanation: 这两个代理技能用于生成裁剪的PNG几何/函数图表和原生可编辑的GeoGebra GGB项目，支持移动点、滑块、代数定义和可选PNG预览。渲染需要Node 18+、Playwright和Chromium，并加载官方GeoGebra网络运行时。无需单独模型API或GPU。
useCases: 生成可编辑的GeoGebra项目
创建几何函数图表的PNG截图
GeoGebra Skills by luzwales.originalDescription: Two agent skills for cropped PNG geometry/function plots and native editable GeoGebra GGB projects with movable points, sliders, algebraic definitions, and optional PNG previews. Requires Node 18+, Playwright, and Chromium; rendering loads the official GeoGebra web runtime over the network. No separate model API or GPU requirement is documented. The README states MIT, but GitHub does not expose a detected repository license.

useCases: 重现代码库中的数据并生成解释性幻灯片
在离线环境中查看生成的幻灯片
slides by kju4q.originalDescription: Claude Code skill that reads a repository, runs its own logic to reproduce numbers, and builds an eight-to-ten-slide self-contained HTML explainer with real code snippets, charts, examples, citations for unreproduced results, and optional live browser simulations. The deck works offline; authoring executes project code and may install its dependencies. Optional headless browser QA checks layout and console errors. No separate API key or GPU requirement is documented.

khan-explainer.name: khan-explainer
khan-explainer.summary: 生成带讲解的板书解释和截图教程的HTML内容
khan-explainer.explanation: 在macOS上使用HTML画布、Playwright、Chromium、ffmpeg和内置语音功能，生成带讲解的板书解释、截图教程和真实音频短视频，支持多种画布类型和语音选项。

生成支持多语言的截图教程
khan-explainer.originalDescription: macOS Claude Code skill for narrated board-drawing explainers, screenshot tutorials, and real-audio shorts, using HTML canvas, Playwright, Chromium, ffmpeg, and built-in say speech. Beat durations follow measured narration; blackboard, whiteboard, landscape, vertical, multilingual text, and contact-sheet QA are supported. Local speech needs no account or API key; optional ElevenLabs sends narration to its API, Kokoro provides local neural speech, faster-whisper transcribes clips locally, and macOS Vision handles optional speaker cutouts. No mandatory GPU is documented.

Arch Diagram Skill by Guangke.name: Arch Diagram Skill by Guangke
Arch Diagram Skill by Guangke.summary: 将自然语言架构需求转换为可编辑的SVG架构图
Arch Diagram Skill by Guangke.explanation: 该工具通过自然语言生成包含系统架构、数据流、网络等的SVG图表。提供多种架构模式和模板，支持可访问的SVG元数据和连接器规范。SVG文件可在本地查看，创作依赖于宿主代理。提供PNG和Mermaid转换指导。
useCases: 根据自然语言描述生成系统架构图
将架构需求转换为可编辑的SVG文件
Arch Diagram Skill by Guangke.originalDescription: Agent Skill for turning natural-language architecture requirements into self-contained editable SVG diagrams across system architecture, data pipelines, networks, behavior, and organization structures. Includes semantic light/dark palettes, accessible SVG metadata, connector conventions, thirteen architecture patterns, microservice/sequence/dataflow templates, and an event-driven example. SVG files can be viewed locally; authoring uses the host agent. No separate API, GPU, or hosted backend requirement is documented; PNG and Mermaid conversion guidance is included.

Axiom Visualization Skills.name: Axiom Visualization Skills
Axiom Visualization Skills.summary: 将数据集和仪表板定义转换为Axiom仪表板，支持过滤和下钻功能
Axiom Visualization Skills.explanation: 该工具将意图、事件/日志数据集、APL或指标查询、Splunk/Grafana仪表板定义转换为Axiom仪表板。需要网络访问和Axiom部署，使用curl和jq进行操作。可本地用Python绘制JSON指标为ASCII图表，支持导出PNG/SVG/sixel格式。
useCases: 将Splunk仪表板转换为Axiom仪表板
本地绘制指标数据为ASCII图表
Axiom Visualization Skills.originalDescription: Official Axiom skill collection including building-dashboards and metrics-chart. Turns intent, event/log datasets, APL or metrics/MPL queries, and Splunk/Grafana dashboard definitions into Axiom dashboards with filters and drilldowns. Dashboard deployment needs network access, an Axiom deployment and credentials; script API tokens are configured separately from hosted MCP OAuth. Helpers use curl and jq. Saved metrics v2/v3 JSON can be plotted locally with Python into ASCII charts without extra packages; optional gnuplot exports PNG/SVG/sixel. No mandatory GPU is documented. Agent and hosted service data handling follows their providers; dashboard and alert helpers can write remote resources.
